data.title: 雷电将军 · 午后咖啡馆
data.description: 咖啡馆临窗的木桌上放着一杯温热的抹茶拿铁，表面的奶泡还留着小小的叶形拉花。雷电影穿紫色长袖便裙，一手轻扶杯耳，另一手把细玻璃吸管停在唇边，刚尝到甜味便微微弯起眼睛。长辫落在肩后，窗外街景变得模糊，她把这段安静的午后留给了与你的闲谈。
data.action: 坐在窗边一手扶杯耳，另一手持细玻璃吸管小口品尝抹茶拿铁，目光放松。
data.camera: medium close-up, eye level, cup and face visible
data.promptProse: The first sweet sip of a warm matcha latte brings a relaxed smile to Raiden Ei at the cafe window. One hand steadies the ceramic mug by its handle while the other holds a slender glass straw at her lips. A small leaf of latte art remains on the foam. Her purple long-sleeved dress and long braid are lit by soft afternoon window light, with the street blurred beyond. Keep the mug, straw and face clear in this close table portrait.
